local_name: tracertraj (copied byte-identical from ../soap/data/agentracer/code on 2026-09-07; the parquet under _source/ is not shipped, the url below is its origin)

source.paper: AgenTracer: Who Is Inducing Failure in the LLM Agentic Systems?

join: parquet row order -> <i>.json, i = 0-based row index
rewrites: turn 'name' becomes 'role' (SOAP reads the agent from 'role')
per-turn 'step' counter dropped; it equals the list index
caveat: Errors are INJECTED, not naturally occurring, so detectability is not comparable to Who&When or CORRECT-Error. Only the test split is public: the repo ships no train parquet, so any SVD fit must come from a split of these 127 trajectories.
